criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is also not safe, allowing the owner to set the total supply of the token to any value.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing the user to set the balance of an arbitrary user to a very large value.
The setPrices function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing the owner to set the buyPrice and sellPrice to a very large value, causing a denial of service.
